div.l: A sompnovr / and a pardoner also
A mancipe and my self / ther was no moo
A MillerTHe millere was / a stowt cherl for the nonys
Wel big he was / of brawn and eek of bonys
That p̉reved wel / for over wher he cam ·
At wrastelyng he wolde / Alwey have the Ram
He was short shuldred / brood and a thikke knare
Ther was no dore / the he ne wolde heve of harre
Or breke it at a rennyng / with his heed
His berd as any sowe / or fox was reed
And therto brood / as thowh it were a spade
Vp on the cop ryht / on his nose he hade
A werte / theron stood a toft of heris
Reed as a brestil . / of a sowis erys ·
His nose therll / blak were and wyde
A swerd and a bokeler / bar he bi his syde
His mouth as gret / as was a gret furnays
He was a gret Iangelere / and a goliardeys
And that was most / of synne and harlatrye
Wel cowde he stele corn · / and tolle thrie
And yet he hadde / a thombe of gold parde
A white coote / and a blew hood wered he
A baggepipe wel cowde he / blowe and sowne
And therwith al / he brought vs out of towne
A Ientyl manciple / was ther of a temple
Of which catowrs / myht take ensample
For to be wys in biggyng / of vitayle
For whethir he payde or took be tayle
Algate he wayted so / in a caat
That he was ay before / and in good astat
Now is that nowht / of god a wol fayr grace
That such a lewde mānys wyt / shal pace
The wisdam · of an heep / of leryd men
